thread:
alice: deploy-bot just posted a failure — main CI turned red right after a merge from @ben. Can someone grab?

deploy-bot: CI FAILED • branch: main • commit: 7f3a2c4
Stage: gpu-smoke
Step: kvalloc/test_alloc
Exit code: 137
Logs:
```
E: kv_allocator: failed to reserve GPU memory: OOM after 1024MB
RuntimeError: allocation failed in device_malloc
--- stack trace truncated ---
```

ben: I only merged a docs change, didn't touch runtime or allocator. pinging @sasha as oncall for GPU infra.

sasha: on it :eyes: pulling logs now and trying a quick local run.

sasha: quick local run `bazel test //smoke:gpu --test_output=errors` reproduces same OOM. Looks like something regressed in allocator behavior.

alice: can we try a straight rerun first before bisecting? if it's transient that saves time.

sasha: rerun queued (build 12346) — link: https://ci.redwood/internal/build/12346

deploy-bot: Rerun started by sasha (build 12346)

sasha: rerun finished and still failing, same trace.

sasha: asking @ben to sanity-check your merge, but since it was docs-only, I'm going to bisect between HEAD~6..HEAD to see which merged change correlates.

ben: ack — I didn't touch code paths but will roll through the bisect. If it points to the allocator change from earlier today, I can revert that PR.

alice: here's a quick triage checklist to keep us aligned:
- capture failing test logs (done)
- try local repro (sasha done)
- rerun CI (done, still fails)
- bisect suspect range (in progress)
- escalate to infra oncall if revert needed

sasha: starting automated bisect now: `scripts/ci/bisect.sh --test //smoke:gpu --range HEAD~6..HEAD`

sasha: if bisect isolates to commit `c4f9e2` (allocator tweak merged 3hrs ago), I'll prepare a rollback PR and tag @infra-leads.

ben: bisect started on my side too, will report first bad commit hash when ready.

alice: thanks — keep updates here. If anyone finds a quick workaround (lower batch size/force host allocation) please note it in the thread.

sasha: temporary workaround tested: set ENV `KVALLOC_RESERVE=512MB` in smoke job reduces OOM but doesn't fully pass. Not a long-term fix.

ben: bisect result on my machine: first bad commit = c4f9e2 (allocator change). Opening revert PR now: https://git.redwood/reverts/345

alice: nice catch. once revert PR is up, let's run a CI smoke-only job before full merge.

sasha: reverting and smoke run queued. tagging @eng-sre for post-merge watch. :thumbsup:
